items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Joe Helbock as the owner of the Onyx club where 'the boys' (including the interviewee) used to stop by, but the interviewee does not explicitly describe a personal relationship or interaction with Helbock.

ctx.x: Drinking. So anyway, there used to be a bar right at the corner of 52nd and Sixth Avenue. All

the boys used to stop by and have a little taste, everybody. Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Kirby, Maxine Sullivan, Billie Pearl Bailey, everybody stop by, fifteen cent a drink, you know, go over there and get a little taste before coming to work. So, the owners of the Onyx club was Joe Helbock, and he and his wife used to sit right there in a little booth as you'd come in the front door. Well the White Rose was about from here to that tree away from the Onyx Club. Well in the White Rose it's close.
That was on the corner of 52nd and 6th.
